skills.installGuide: How to Install in AI Agents
skills.installStep1: Save the file content as SKILL.md inside your agent's skills folder (e.g., .claude/skills/skill-name/SKILL.md or .agents/skills/).
skills.installStep2: Ensure YAML frontmatter contains valid name and instruction descriptions.
skills.installStep3: Run your agent; it will recognize and apply the instructions automatically.
